preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 100000 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length n is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) and len(s) == n and all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in s) for n, s in zip(ns, ss))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the string s has length n and consists only of lowercase English letters.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(r, int) for r in results)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all((r == -1) or (r >= 0) for r in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is either -1 (impossible) or a non-negative integer (minimum erasures).

postconditions.expression: all((r == -1) or (r == min_erasures(n, s)) for r, n, s in zip(results, ns, ss))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if possible, the result is the minimum number of erasures required to make the string a palindrome by removing occurrences of exactly one chosen character; otherwise, it is -1.
